title: 2013 HMMT February Combinatorics Problem 2
statement: If Alex does not sing on Saturday, then she has a \(70 \%\) chance of singing on Sunday; however, to rest her voice, she never sings on both days. If Alex has a \(50 \%\) chance of singing on Sunday, find the probability that she sings on Saturday.

solutions.text: \(\sqrt{\frac{2}{7}}\) Let \(p\) be the probability that Alex sings on Saturday. Then, the probability that she sings on Sunday is \(.7(1-p)\); setting this equal to .5 gives \(p=\frac{2}{7}\).
